title: Download full-size SoundCloud cover art
question: How do I download the full-size cover art of a SoundCloud track?
answer: SoundCloud has no download button for cover art, and the artwork on a track page is a 500x500 preview. The usermods script on this page adds a "Full-size cover art" link under the artwork on track and playlist pages that opens the image at the size it was uploaded, ready to save. Without a script, find the artwork address ending in -t500x500.jpg with your browser's inspector and replace t500x500 with original.
prompt: Add a link under the SoundCloud artwork that opens the cover art at full size.
details:
SoundCloud serves track artwork from `i1.sndcdn.com` at fixed sizes such as `-t500x500.jpg`, and keeps the uploaded file at the same address ending in `-original`. The script reads the address from the big artwork on the page, swaps the size for `original` and puts the result in a link under the image. It updates the link when you move to another track without a reload. Nothing is downloaded until you click.

The link opens the image in a new tab, where you save it as usual; browsers ignore the `download` attribute for images on another domain. The check loads a track page; playlist pages use the same artwork block.

alternatives.title: Edit the image address
alternatives.body: Open the browser inspector on the artwork, copy the `background-image` address ending in `-t500x500.jpg`, replace `t500x500` with `original` and open it.

evidence.note: SoundCloud Enhanced Pro (users, read on the detail page); multi-purpose extension, not counted in the score

returns "soundcloud artwork downloader"; suggestions: soundcloud artwork downloader | soundcloud artwork downloader extension | soundcloud image downloader | soundcloud song artwork downloader | soundcloud cover art downloader extension

check.expect: (() => { const a = document.querySelector('.listenArtworkWrapper a.usermods-cover-art'); return !!a && a.checkVisibility() && a.href === 'https://i1.sndcdn.com/artworks-000067273316-smsiqx-original.jpg' && a.textContent === 'Full-size cover art'; })()
